```yaml
name: Clean Unused Strings

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # Run monthly at 2 AM on the 1st
    - cron: '0 2 1 * *'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  clean-unused-strings:
    runs-on: macos-15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@8e8c483db84b4bee98b60c0593521ed34d9990e8  # v6.0.1
        with:
          ssh-key: ${{ secrets.HOMEASSISTANT_SSH_DEPLOY_KEY }}

      - name: Install Brews
        run: brew bundle

      - name: Install Gems
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Install Pods
        run: ONLY_SUPPORT_MODULES=1 bundle exec pod install --repo-update

      - name: Run unused strings detection
        id: detect
        run: |
          python3 Tools/detect_unused_strings.py
          echo "unused_count=$(cat /tmp/unused_strings_count.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check for unused strings
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count > 0
        run: |
          echo "Found ${{ steps.detect.outputs.unused_count }} unused strings"
          echo "Proceeding with cleanup..."

      - name: Remove unused strings
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count > 0
        run: |
          python3 Tools/remove_unused_strings.py
          echo "Cleanup completed"

      - name: Regenerate Strings.swift
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count > 0
        run: |
          bundle exec swiftgen
          echo "Strings.swift regenerated"

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count > 0
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'Home Assistant Bot'
          git config --global user.email 'hello@home-assistant.io'
          git add Sources/*.strings Sources/*.swift
          git commit -m "Clean up unused localization strings" || true
          git push origin HEAD:cleanup-unused-strings-${{ github.run_id }} || true

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count > 0
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@98357b18bf14b5342f975ff684046ec3b2a07725  # v8.0.0
        with:
          base: main
          branch: cleanup-unused-strings-${{ github.run_id }}
          title: "Clean up unused localization strings"
          body: "This PR was automatically generated to remove unused localization strings detected by the cleanup workflow.\n\nUnused strings found: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.unused_count }}"
          token: ${{ secrets.REPO_SCOPED_TOKEN }}
```
